title: Haliphron structured output envelope
description: Schema of the runs/{runID}/output.json object. The envelope is filled in by the entrypoint; the agent writes only the payload — the contents of data — to /workspace/.haliphron/output.json. The split is deliberate: every formatting requirement placed on the model is a chance to burn a paid run on a forgotten field, whereas everything mechanical here is filled in by the machine without mistakes. The schema of data itself is declared by the workflow node; in v1 there are no nodes, and data is validated by nothing.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of the runtime contract. A consumer that encounters a higher one must refuse, not pick through the keys it recognizes.

status.description: Derived from the exit code rather than declared by the agent: partial means a timeout after which there is work all the same; failed means the output was kept for the post-mortem, not because anyone trusts it.

summary.description: The first 64 KiB of result.md. Duplicated here so that a consumer of the structured output does not have to fetch a second object for one line of UI.

data.description: The payload exactly as the agent wrote it. An empty object is a legal value and the normal outcome of a run with no declared schema.

artifacts.description: Files from /workspace/.haliphron/artifacts/, uploaded under the runs/{runID}/artifacts/ prefix. References, not contents: nothing bounds the size here.
